prior.claim_boundary: Every listed state already has a published source prediction. Related compositions or phases are not experimental confirmation of this exact state. This dossier does not establish global novelty or an exhaustive literature search.

bottleneck.summary: Large all-token paired gain is supported, but fine-grid stress reaches 0.364 GPa and residual force 0.02598 eV/A on coarse-relaxed coordinates. Source pressure-zero relaxation and local phonon minimum justify only a finite coarse-grid metastable hypothesis. Tc/W/Re chemistry and SOC/mass are coupled; no pure high-W or carrier causal statement.
bottleneck.ambient_scope: Source coarse force 0.00016352217457471632 eV/Å, pressure -0.0 GPa; fine force 0.025977914268365074 eV/Å, pressure -0.34700000000000003 GPa. Actual full stress, Γ interval, finite path and q observations are retained in the complete review; no whole-BZ/global-stability claim.

proposed_contribution.intervention: Re-to-Tc construction on the Mo-W trigonal role network. coupled chemical/site-role/volume/mass construction, not isolated geometry or inferred W/n
proposed_contribution.next_action: Inspect existing exact target/control mode/orbital evidence and stress/phase competition. Favorable: local near-zero-pressure role construction retains pairing advantage under matched refinement; adverse: cell strain or competing phase removes favorable branch; ambiguous: conditional internal-force scale cannot answer strain stability.
proposed_contribution.falsifier: Reproduce the stated target and control with matched pseudopotential family, functional, cutoff, sampling and relevant spin/SOC treatment. Loss or reversal of the claimed response, instability of the target, or an unresolved competing phase changes the decision; ambiguous outcomes remain unresolved.
proposed_contribution.new_state_inheritance: A child structure or modification needs its own calculation and identity. It does not inherit source Tc or experimental status.
